reason: سْمِ is governed by the prefixed بِ in the formula بِسْمِ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of سْمِ.
ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ follows ٱللَّهِ in genitive definiteness as an adjectival divine epithet.
ٱلرَّحِيمِ follows ٱللَّهِ in the same genitive adjectival series.
أَلَمْ contains the jussive لَمْ governing the apocopated verb نَشْرَحْ.
The pronoun in لَكَ is governed by لِ as the beneficiary complement of نَشْرَحْ.
صَدْرَكَ is the accusative object opened by نَشْرَحْ.
The suffix كَ in صَدْرَكَ is the possessive complement of صَدْر.
The pronoun in عَنكَ is governed by عَنْ as the removal complement of وَضَعْنَا.
وِزْرَكَ is the accusative thing removed by وَضَعْنَا.
The suffix كَ in وِزْرَكَ is the possessive complement of وِزْر.
ٱلَّذِىٓ supplies the visible relative subject associated with أَنقَضَ.
ظَهْرَكَ is the accusative object affected by أَنقَضَ.
The suffix كَ in ظَهْرَكَ is the possessive complement of ظَهْر.
The pronoun in لَكَ is governed by لِ as the beneficiary complement of رَفَعْنَا.
ذِكْرَكَ is the accusative object raised by رَفَعْنَا.
The suffix كَ in ذِكْرَكَ is the possessive complement of ذِكْر.
ٱلْعُسْرِ is genitive after the ظرف مَعَ, forming مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ.
يُسْرًا is the accusative delayed ism governed by إِنَّ.
مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ is the fronted khabar attached to إِنَّ.
ٱلْعُسْرِ is genitive after the ظرف مَعَ, forming مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ.
يُسْرًۭا is the accusative delayed ism governed by إِنَّ.
مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ is the fronted khabar attached to إِنَّ.
إِذَا supplies the temporal condition under which فَرَغْتَ is framed.
رَبِّكَ is governed by إِلَىٰ as the fronted directional complement of ٱرْغَبْ.
The suffix كَ in رَبِّكَ is the possessive complement of رَبّ.
